# Roblox Teleport System

A save and teleport system for Roblox that allows you to save positions and teleport to them anytime.

## Features
- Save unlimited positions
- Teleport to any saved position
- Clear all saved positions
- Delete individual positions
- Visual effects for saving/teleporting
- Keyboard shortcuts (S: save, C: clear, H: toggle GUI)

## How to Use
3. Execute the script in any-game
4. Use the GUI or keyboard shortcuts to save and teleport
